# Code of Conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good faith, keep discussion about the work, and
no harassment of any kind, in issues, pull requests, discussions or anywhere
else you act on behalf of the project.

## Enforcement

The maintainer, Yehuda Briskman, enforces it. To report a problem, contact the
maintainer privately through the contact form on
[yehudabriskman.com](https://yehudabriskman.com). Reports are handled in
confidence. The maintainer may edit, hide or delete comments, close issues, and
block accounts that break this code, following the Covenant's
[enforcement guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines).
